name: s233-designer-king
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world = clone(DEFAULTS.world); Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "castleroom", castle: "N", castleRoom: 1, things: [] }); tab = TABS.findIndex(t => /Background/.test(t[0])); showTab(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll("#panel button")].find(x => /open the castle designer/.test(x.textContent)); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); const r1 = [...document.querySelectorAll(".designer button")].find(x => /^👑 1$|king/.test(x.textContent) && !/go there/.test(x.textContent)); if (r1) r1.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const w = [...document.querySelectorAll(".designer button")].find(x => /way out/.test(x.textContent)); if (w) w.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const d = document.querySelector(".designer"); if (d) d.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" }); window.__report = { edit: d ? d.querySelector(".row:nth-of-type(2)") && [...d.querySelectorAll(".row")].map(x => x.textContent).filter(t => /leads to/.test(t)) : null };
